sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Publishing of Massively Multiplayer Online Role-Playing Games

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid — Common Law statutory corporate framework (Modeled on Delaware) with customary law and U.S.-influenced procedural elements
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association with the United States (COFA, 1986, as amended)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER-Plus, 2020)
Hague Convention Abolishing the Requirement of Legalisation for Foreign Public Documents (Apostille Convention, applied as of 1992)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Title 51, Business Corporations Act 1990 (as amended) of the Revised Code of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI), requiring every domestic corporation to keep and file a confidential beneficial ownership register; Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2017 (as amended), RMI Public Law 17-29, together with the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) Regulations 2020; Beneficial Ownership (Register) Regulations 2020; and FATF recommendations as applied by the Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG).
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access — Beneficial ownership information is filed confidentially with the Registrar of Corporations and disclosed only to the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit, law enforcement, and authorized competent authorities upon lawful request; nominee shareholders for non-resident corporations are permissible but the natural-person UBO must be disclosed to the registered agent and to the Registrar on the confidential UBO register.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the constitutional document (Articles of Incorporation / Charter) of any corporate shareholder, if the UBO is an entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry or notary in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the designated competent authority of the country of origin; where the country of origin is not party to the Apostille Convention, processing through the RMI Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade with prior consular legalization at an authorized RMI diplomatic or consular post

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized passport bio-page or national identity card of each ultimate beneficial owner, director, and nominee officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport office or national identification authority of the holder's country, followed by notarization
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or, for non-Apostille jurisdictions, consular legalization by RMI consular authorities or a designated diplomatic mission

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or banking reference) of each UBO, dated within three (3) months
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed financial institution in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization by a civil-law notary or solicitor, followed by Hague Apostille / consular legalization as applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference / professional due diligence certificate issued by the onboarding registered agent, to be notarized as a corporate attestation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: RMI-licensed registered agent or a recognized AML/CFT-approved legal counsel
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization by the issuing agent or counsel; if the issuer is outside a Hague Convention state, completion of consular legalization

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all applicants, shareholders, directors, nominees, and UBOs against the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit consolidated sanctions list, the United States Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List (SDN), the U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security Entity List, the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, the European Union Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the United Kingdom HM Treasury Consolidated List; enhanced due diligence required for politically exposed persons ('PEPs'), including ongoing transaction monitoring and senior management approval in accordance with AMLCFTA 2017 s.12 and FATF Recommendation 12.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RMI e-Registry — Corporate Name Search and Reservation Portal, operated by the Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All corporate names must be submitted in Latin alphabetic characters. The name must be in English, or, if a foreign language is used, it must be accompanied by a certified transliteration into Roman characters. The name must be distinctive and must not, in the opinion of the Registrar, be misleading, deceptive, or identical or deceptively similar to an existing name in the RMI register. Prefixes, suffixes and spacing must be strictly consistent with the RMI Business Corporations Act transliteration policy.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation is valid for thirty (30) calendar days from the date the Registrar of Corporations grants the reservation. A single extension of thirty (30) calendar days may be obtained by filing a renewal application with the required fee prior to expiry of the initial reservation. If the Registrar rejects a name application because it is not distinguishable, is identical to an existing name, or contains a prohibited or sensitive token without prior ministerial approval, the applicant may submit a written administrative appeal to the Office of the Registrar of Corporations within fourteen (14) calendar days after the date of the rejection notice. The Registrar shall determine the appeal within twenty-one (21) calendar days. If the administrative appeal is denied, the applicant may petition the High Court of the Republic of the Marshall Islands for judicial review in accordance with the RMI Administrative Procedure Act and Business Corporations Act s.14.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for a non-resident Business Corporation engaged in global software publishing (ISIC 5820) and MMORPG distribution. The BCA requires maintenance of a registered office in the Republic of the Marshall Islands, which must equate to the street address of a duly licensed RMI registered agent. A virtual office serviced by that registered agent is accepted, provided the agent maintains a physical presence, receives enforceable service of process, and keeps the statutory corporate records and UBO register. No physical commercial premises in the RMI is required for non-resident limited-liability entities.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low — approximately 5% annual likelihood for a standard, non-resident, tax-exempt digital content publisher. The Office of the Registrar of Corporations does not conduct routine unannounced physical inspections of non-resident enterprises; physical visitation at the registered agent address occurs only upon court warrant, in connection with a criminal investigation, or upon the specific enforcement request of the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit. Regulatory inspections, if any, are principally documentary audits of the registered agent's books and UBO records.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate name search and name reservation fee (initial, non-refundable)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, RMI Ministry of Finance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory name reservation tariff set out in the RMI Corporate Registry Fee Schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Filing fee for Articles of Incorporation (authorized capital up to US$50,000)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, RMI Ministry of Finance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory filing fee under the Business Corporations Act 1990 (as amended) and the approved Government Fee Schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Non-Resident Business Exemption Certificate / Government license (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: RMI Ministry of Finance / Office of the Registrar of Corporations
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory annual license fee for tax-exempt non-resident entities, payable to the Government of the Republic of the Marshall Islands

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent fee and registered office service (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a licensed RMI corporate services provider, inclusive of registered office and process agent services

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Confidential UBO register filing and AML/CFT screening processing fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, RMI Financial Intelligence Unit (filing component through registered agent)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee for beneficial ownership register filing under the Beneficial Ownership Regulations 2020

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, Hague Apostille, and/or consular legalization of UBO and certificate of good standing documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public, competent apostille authority, and RMI consular authorities (as applicable)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing government and notarial tariff in the country of origin; inclusive of translations and certified copies

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act (BCA), Title 51 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code, as amended, particularly Sections 7 (Lawful Purposes), 106 (Articles of Incorporation), 108 (Registered Office and Registered Agent), 111 (Directors), and 149 (Corporate Records, Waiver of Notice, and Action by Written Consent).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands, Majuro Atoll (administrative filing services delegated to Marshall Islands Maritime and Corporate Administrators, Inc., through accredited registered agents).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Form BC-1) filed electronically or in paper form with the Office of the Registrar of Corporations, accompanied by the Registered Agent Consent and Appointment Form.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is imposed; the BCA permits shares with or without par value and any amount of authorized capital. There is no escrow or deposit account requirement for incorporation; the subscriber may declare the issued share consideration fully paid in exchange for services, platform rights, or cash as recorded in the share ledger.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Articles of Incorporation were duly authorized and filed with the Registrar of Corporations on 3 September 2025, and that the subscription for the authorized shares by the founding shareholders is accepted, ratified, and declared fully paid and non-assessable. RESOLVED, that the registered office in the Republic of the Marshall Islands shall be at the registered agent's address set forth in the Articles, and the registered agent's appointment is confirmed. RESOLVED, that the following persons are appointed officers until successors are duly elected: [●] President, [●] Secretary, and [●] Treasurer, each authorized to open bank accounts, execute contracts, and effectuate corporate purposes.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations (via request through an accredited Marshall Islands registered agent or the MICA online portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two or three proposed corporate names in order of preference for a deconfliction search against the corporate register. The name must contain 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Limited', or an abbreviation, and must not be misleadingly similar to an existing registered name. Upon approval, pay the reservation fee to reserve the name for 30 days, with one renewal period available.
required_dossiers: Name Reservation Request Form (Form NR-1)
Proposed corporate names (up to three alternatives)
Government name reservation fee of USD 40
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for confusing similarity, resubmit an alternative name from the approved list within 3 business days or request a name reservation extension for an additional 30 days by paying the renewal fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporator, Notary Public, and qualified Marshall Islands corporate counsel
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft Articles of Incorporation under Section 106 of the BCA, specifying the corporate name, registered office address, registered agent name, purpose clause (broad lawful purpose for software publishing and global digital distribution), authorized share structure, and names of initial directors. The incorporator must sign the Articles before a notary public; the signature must be witnessed and the instrument dated.
required_dossiers: Articles of Incorporation signed by the incorporator
Notarized acknowledgment of the incorporator's signature
Consent of incorporator to act in that capacity
Initial director consent forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar objects to a narrow purpose clause, the corporation may amend the Articles to adopt a broader lawful purpose clause under Section 7 of the BCA and file Articles of Amendment; no re-execution of the original filing is required if the defect is merely stylistic.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Registered Agent and Registered Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Marshall Islands registered agent licensed by the Registrar of Corporations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the Registered Agent Consent and Appointment Form, appointing a licensed Marshall Islands entity to serve as the corporation's registered agent with a physical street address in Majuro or Ebeye. Confirm that the agent accepts service of process and will act as the domestic correspondent for annual report and ownership filing obligations.
required_dossiers: Registered Agent Consent and Appointment Form
Registered Agent Service Agreement
Proof of physical registered office address in the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent's appointment lapses, the Registrar will issue a notice of resignation; a successor agent must be appointed within 30 days by filing the Change of Registered Agent or Registered Office Form, failing which administrative dissolution may proceed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing with the Registrar and Payment of Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed and notarized Articles of Incorporation together with the Registered Agent Consent, cover letter from the accredited service company, and the government filing fee of USD 250. The Registrar will review the document for statutory compliance, stamp the Articles, and issue the Certificate of Incorporation with a file number.
required_dossiers: Executed and notarized Articles of Incorporation
Registered Agent Consent and Appointment Form
Government filing fee of USD 250
Cover letter from the accredited filing service company
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is queried for an omission (for example, missing signature page, incomplete share schedule, or unpaid fee), file a corrective statement or supplementary submission with the Registrar within 21 days of the query; late correction incurs a USD 10 per day penalty up to a maximum of USD 250.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Meeting, Bylaws, and First Board Resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the organizational meeting or execute a unanimous written consent of the sole initial director in lieu of a meeting. Adopt the Bylaws, approve the pro-forma First Board Resolution covering share subscription, registered office adoption, and officer appointments, and issue share certificates to the founding shareholders. Minute book and share ledger must be opened.
required_dossiers: Bylaws
Pro-forma First Board Resolution (as set out in this dossier)
Unanimous written consent of the initial director in lieu of an organizational meeting
Share subscription agreements and share certificate stubs
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Not applicable to public registration; any internal procedural defect is cured by a subsequent unanimous written consent of the directors and shareholders, which has the same effect as a duly called meeting under Section 149 of the BCA.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations and Apple/Google platform merchant registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the initial ownership report identifying directors, officers, and shareholders, and confirm the non-resident status with the Marshall Islands Tax Administration (no domestic income tax applies to non-resident foreign income). Register the corporate bank account under the board resolution and conclude Apple App Store and Google Play merchant payout agreements for MMORPG in-app purchase revenues.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and stamped Articles
Board resolution appointing officers and authorizing bank and platform account opening
Ownership report (Form OR-1) with director and shareholder details
Apple App Store and Google Play merchant application forms and tax withholding certificates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the ownership report is overdue, the Registrar imposes a late fee of USD 50 per month; the remedy is immediate submission with payment. Any merchant platform rejection is cured by correcting the beneficial owner and banking details in the payout profile.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable — ISIC 5820 (Software Publishing) is a non-industrial digital services activity; the entity operates as a non-resident publisher with no factory, processing plant, or physical manufacturing establishment in the Republic of the Marshall Islands.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Required — No industrial, manufacturing, or commercial occupancy permit applies to this non-resident software publisher; MMORPG distribution is effected solely through Apple App Store and Google Play payout rails outside the territory of the Marshall Islands.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMIEPA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — Office-based software publishing is not a prescribed undertaking listed in Schedule A of the Environmental Protection Act 1984, and the activity generates no point-source discharge, so neither an EIA Registration nor a Full EIA Report is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: N/A — Zero wastewater, VOC, or point-source emissions are generated. The company remains subject to the general duty to dispose of office solid waste through approved municipal collection and to manage e-waste and spent batteries in accordance with the RMI Integrated Solid Waste Management Strategy, with no measurable discharge thresholds applicable.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No fire safety, structural load, or heavy machinery certification is required for a non-resident software publisher. If a physical office is maintained in Majuro, the premises must comply with the RMI Building Code fire egress and extinguisher requirements, pass an electrical safety inspection, and satisfy workstation ergonomic and workplace health standards under the Occupational Health and Safety Act 2007; a standard office occupancy clearance from the local fire authority suffices.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance, Government of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (official portal: https://www.rmigovernment.org; tax administration is exercised through the Tax and Revenue Division).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A non-resident Business Corporation (BC) incorporated under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act is exempt from income tax and is not statutorily required to obtain a separate TIN or VAT ID. The Registrar of Corporations issues a unique Corporate Registration Number, which serves as the identity number for all government filings, including the annual government fee and any business license application. If a creditor, bank, or counterparty requires a tax identification number, the Company may file an administrative request with the Tax and Revenue Division attaching the Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing, and the Division issues a letter-based TIN for administrative, FATCA, and CRS identification purposes. This TIN does not impose tax registration or return filing obligations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. The Marshall Islands imposes no entity-level income tax on non-resident Business Corporations and provides no check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election in domestic law. A U.S. owner may independently file an entity classification election (Form 8832) under U.S. Treasury Regulations Section 301.7701-3; this election is exclusively a U.S. federal tax action and has no Marshall Islands statutory counterpart.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None (no VAT, GST, sales tax, or use tax is imposed at the national level; only customs import duties on selected physical goods and certain municipal licenses exist outside the tax-exempt regime).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable - no VAT/GST registration threshold exists because no indirect tax is levied on non-resident service exporters or on exported digital services.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No electronic invoicing, fiscal clearance, API integration, or digital stamping mandate exists under Marshall Islands law.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable. The Republic of the Marshall Islands does not impose a VAT or GST regime, and therefore no export zero-rating allowance or refund mechanism is available or necessary for MMORPG services or digital goods sold by a non-resident Business Corporation to global customers.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: No customs declaration is required for digital services; physical export shipments, if any, are subject only to the RMI Customs Export Declaration and Bill of Lading.
Inward Remittance Certificate is not required by tax law; it may be requested by banking counterparties for AML/KYC purposes only.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Not applicable in zero-rating form because no VAT refund clawback regime exists. General company law penalties apply to knowing misrepresentations made to the Registrar or Tax Division; such conduct may lead to fines up to USD 5,000, dissolution, and criminal liability under the Penal and Traffic Code if committed with fraudulent intent.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands (no formal central bank; the United States Federal Reserve is the de facto issuing authority for the circulating currency, the U.S. Dollar).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The U.S. Dollar is the sole official currency of the Marshall Islands; there is no separate domestic currency and no exchange-control legislation. Capital account and current account transactions are fully convertible, with no statutory barriers to inward investment or outward profit remittance. Repatriation of dividends, royalties, or dissolution proceeds may be effected freely by bank wire, subject only to standard bank due diligence and anti-money-laundering screening. No exchange rate spread or surrender requirement is imposed for non-resident owners.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable. No statutory timeline or mandatory conversion ratio exists for export receipts. A Marshall Islands exporter or publisher may retain receivables in U.S. Dollars indefinitely, whether held domestically or abroad, and no remittance into a local account is legally required.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-Medium. The Marshall Islands does not maintain a dedicated digital currency or electronic money institution (EMI) licensing framework. Offshore digital EMIs must rely on money-transmitter licenses or local bank partnerships to operate in the country, and a fully remote EMI arrangement is generally not sufficient for high-volume MMORPG treasury operations. A licensed U.S.-based money services business or a regulated fintech with a U.S. state Money Transmitter License may be acceptable if a local RMI bank retains the settlement account relationship.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance of directors is not categorically mandatory, but the compliance officer of the chosen financial institution must complete a remote video verification or a locally executed notarized KYC/in-person interview through a recognized agent. For the Bank of Marshall Islands, a certified copy of the passport, proof of business address, certified corporate registry documents, and a notarized resolution of the board opening the account are required. Directors resident outside the Marshall Islands may complete identity verification through the bank's overseas correspondent or a licensed introducer, provided the account's authorized signatories are identified and, if requested, present in person at the bank's head office in Majuro.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Bearer share and unlisted share ownership opacity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified register of beneficial owners pursuant to the Marshall Islands Beneficial Ownership Regulations; written declaration confirming no bearer shares are outstanding or that all bearer shares are immobilized and held by a licensed custodian; certified government-issued identity documents for every ultimate beneficial owner; corporate resolution designating a designated natural person for AML/CFT compliance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident tax-exempt corporation inconsistent with primary revenue profile
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Legal opinion from a Marshall Islands attorney confirming the corporation's tax-exempt status under the Business Corporation Act and its non-conduct of local business; copy of the Certificate of Good Standing issued by the Registrar; audited or management accounts demonstrating that all revenue originates from global app stores and not from physical presence in the Marshall Islands; sworn affidavit explaining the commercial substance of the MMORPG business.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity digital transactions from MMORPG in-app purchases triggering money laundering red flags
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Written compliance manual detailing transaction monitoring and geographic/FX rules; historical settlement records from Apple App Store and Google Play payouts demonstrating the origin of funds; containment policy requiring platform settlement in USD only; periodic independent AML review and an agreement to provide bank statements or platform payout records upon request.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear source of wealth for capital escrow injection from non-resident shareholders
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank reference letters from the remitting institution; sworn wealth statement and documentation supporting the source of capital (e.g., shareholder tax returns, sale/merger agreements, inheritance instruments); tri-party escrow agreement for the initial capitalization; evidence of no adverse media or sanctions match for all beneficial owners.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital is routed through the SWIFT MT103 system to the Bank of Marshall Islands or Bank of Guam account using the recipient entity's name, address, and account number. The remitting bank must state the beneficiary as the Marshall Islands Business Corporation and use the SWIFT purpose code COST (for capital contribution) or, for equity investment, the ISO 20022 transaction type code BUSE or INVS. The underlying documents (board resolution, subscribed capital schedule, shareholder identification, and evidence of the source of funds) must be retained and submitted to the receiving bank within its documentary collection window. For U.S.-dollar payments from App Store platforms, the receiving instruction should include the RMI bank's ABA/CHIPS identifier where available.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements for MMORPG publishing services and licensor distributions are executed through SWIFT MT103 priority transfers for immediate value, commercial letters of credit (confirmation by the correspondent bank) for milestone-based development agreements, and, for routine small-value royalties, ACH or direct deposit in U.S. Dollars where the counterparty is U.S.-based. All outbound payments require the standard MT103 field 70 (remittance information) to include the invoice number, product code, and tax treatment reference, allowing the clearing bank to verify compliance with sanctions and anti-money-laundering screening.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD-denominated FX forwards against convertible currencies (e.g., EUR/USD, GBP/USD) for planned contractor settlements and app-store proceeds conversion
Cross-currency swaps where the MMORPG entity has dual-currency exposure from licensing or development agreements
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) restricted to jurisdictions with restricted currencies; each must be separately approved by the settlement bank's treasury desk

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report Filing and Franchise Tax Payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually before the anniversary month of incorporation (filing available from 60 days prior to anniversary)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee of USD 150; continued non-filing for 90 days results in administrative dissolution and loss of good standing

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Year-end confirmation or upon anniversary as required by agent agreement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to retain registered agent leads to Registrar notification; persistent non-compliance triggers administrative strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Economic Substance Return (No Economic Substance Claim)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Marshall Islands Tax Administration (economic substance filing portal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within 12 months after end of the financial year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty of USD 10,000 for late filing; possible further administrative penalty and potential strike-off for egregious non-compliance

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit required for non-resident business corporations; audit only required by shareholder resolution, lenders, or for regulated activities
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act permits accounting records under GAAP acceptable to directors; IFRS recommended for global operations

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annual confirmation of registered shareholder list is not separately filed; changes in shareholders and beneficial ownership must be recorded in the Register of Members maintained at the registered office, with updated details available to the Registrar upon request

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 500 – USD 1,500 (licensed registered agent annual fee)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not mandatory; if performed, typically USD 5,000 – USD 15,000 for a mid-size gaming entity

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 32% of net income derived from sources within the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) as provided under the Marshall Islands Income Tax Act 1987, Section 441.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% effective rate for a Non-Resident Domestic Business Corporation under Section 13 of the RMI Business Corporations Act: all income derived from sources outside the RMI is exempt from RMI income tax. No capital gains tax, no gross receipts tax, no value-added tax. Only a flat annual business license fee applies (customarily USD 3,000 based on an assumed net income of USD 100,000 at 3%).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 1120-RMI (Corporation Income Tax Return), with Form RMI-NRDC-E (Exempt Non-Resident Domestic Corporation Declaration of No Tax Liability). Filing is accepted via the RMI Tax Office electronic portal (ETax-RMI) or by physical submission to the RMI Tax Office, Majuro; annual reports and business license renewals go through the RMI Registrar of Corporations.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Return and payment due on the 15th day of the 4th month following the close of the fiscal year. Exempt Non-Resident Domestic Corporations must file the exempt declaration and renew the business license on or before 31 March annually for a calendar-year entity or the last day of the 4th month after a non-calendar fiscal year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross income derived from sources within the RMI, including in-country subscriptions, local distribution or RMI payment-rail settlements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter zero if all revenue is sourced outside the RMI through foreign app stores; attach a schedule tracing Apple App Store and Google Play settlement routing to non-RMI jurisdictions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ordinary and necessary business expenses attributable to RMI-source income, mapped to the RMI Income Tax Act deduction provisions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident domestic corporations claiming full exemption should enter zero; keep supporting expense documentation outside the return for potential examiner review.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Box 1 minus Box 2; taxable base for RMI-source activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Zero for offshore MMORPG publishing; no allocable RMI-source income where no local sales force, server, or payment intermediary is RMI-based.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory 32% tax on RMI net income or the Section 13 exemption election.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exemption code 'BC-S13' and USD 0.00; attach the certified copy of the Non-Resident Domestic Corporation charter endorsement.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature under penalty of perjury verifying completeness and accuracy.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be signed by a director or authorized officer with RMI apostilled authority; power-of-attorney documentation must accompany remote filings.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of 5% of unpaid tax per month or fraction thereof, capped at 25%; late payment penalty 0.5% per month up to 25%; interest accrues at the statutory underpayment rate. Negligence penalty 20%; civil fraud penalty 75% of the underpayment. Exempt declaration omission triggers penalty of USD 500 plus USD 50 per day of continuing delinquency. Failure to file the corporate annual report triggers Registrar late fees of USD 100 per month and potential administrative dissolution after 12 months.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — the RMI Income Tax Act imposes no statutory dividend withholding tax on distributions by a Non-Resident Domestic Business Corporation to non-resident shareholders; dividends from RMI-source income paid to non-residents are equally exempt from source-based withholding.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The RMI has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network; the only quasi-treaty mechanisms are the Compact of Free Association income tax provisions with the United States, which do not reduce any RMI dividend withholding because none exists. Where a marginal DTA credit is claimed in a foreign shareholder's residence state: (1) apply to the RMI Tax Office for a Certificate of Tax Residency (TRC) confirming the BC as an RMI-resident entity not deriving RMI-source income; (2) file the TRC with a Form RMI-W8 equivalent through the foreign revenue authority; (3) attach an audited statement showing the dividend funded exclusively from non-RMI-source profits. No advance ruling or treaty clearance is required for outbound dividends.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate: 0% withholding on arm's-length royalties for intellectual property (including MMORPG game code, content licenses, and trademark royalties) and 0% withholding on interest paid to non-resident lenders, provided the payer has no RMI-source allocable income. Treaty rate: not applicable; no RMI tax treaty modifies these rates for any counterparty jurisdiction.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: USD 500,000 (the RMI incorporates an IRC Section 482 analog but prescribes no explicit mandatory Local File/Master File threshold; a documentation file is recommended when aggregate related-party cross-border transactions, including app-store settlement flows and IP licensing, exceed USD 500,000 per annum in USD, which is the local currency).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The RMI imposes no Economic Substance Regulations analogous to the UAE or BVI. A Non-Resident Domestic Business Corporation must, however, demonstrate bona fide existence under common-law veil-piercing standards: a registered agent in the RMI, a physical or agent-held office, quorum-valid board actions, maintained corporate records and statutory registers, and demonstrable decision-making substance for global MMORPG publishing treasury and IP management. Absence of such substance converts a tax-exempt BC into an indicia-bearing shell and invites deregistration and adverse U.S. FATCA/CFC consequences for U.S.-person shareholders.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Willful filing of a false Form 1120-RMI declaration denying RMI-source income when in-app purchases are routed through RMI-based payment processing, RMI App Store settlement accounts, or RMI bank accounts; deliberate concealment of gross receipts derived from RMI customers or RMI distribution platforms.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil fraud penalty of 75% of the underpayment; criminal fine of up to USD 10,000 and imprisonment of up to 5 years under the RMI Income Tax Act criminal provisions; the tax deficiency plus interest becomes a statutory lien on corporate assets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts will pierce the corporate veil where the BC is a facade for the dominant owner; directors are jointly and severally liable for the tax deficiency and penalties upon a finding of fraudulent conveyance; willful misstatement by a signing director triggers personal criminal exposure, possible extradition under the RMI-US Compact, travel bans from entering the United States and RMI, and imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Non-Resident Domestic Corporation exemption solely as a tax haven wrapper without any board meetings, registered agent compliance, economic substance, or legitimate commercial rationale, particularly when the MMORPG publishing activity is entirely managed from Manila, Singapore, or the United States with only mailbox representation in Majuro.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Registrar of Corporations may revoke the certificate of incorporation, administratively dissolve the entity, and strike it from the RMI register; the entity loses limited liability protection and exemption status retroactively, triggering the 32% statutory tax and business license back assessments.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face civil restitution to creditors and shareholders for continued trading after revocation; travel bans may be imposed by RMI courts in fraud actions; egregious abuse may result in criminal charges for false declaration under the Business Corporations Act, with imprisonment of up to 2 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Anti-Money Laundering / App-Store Payment Rails Misuse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Exploiting the low-risk classification of Apple App Store and Google Play in-app purchase settlements to launder proceeds, process prohibited virtual-currency cash-outs, or structure transactions to evade foreign reporting obligations; operating without an RMI AML compliance program where the entity holds RMI bank accounts or payment licenses.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Banking Act and AML/CFT regulations: monetary penalties of up to USD 500,000 per violation for financial institutions; freezing of corporate accounts; license revocation; criminal money-laundering penalties of USD 500,000 and imprisonment of 10 to 20 years for principals.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly allow the corporation to be used for money laundering are personally subject to criminal indictment, asset seizure and civil forfeiture, international travel bans pending extradition, and imprisonment; personal restitution is ordered for funds laundered through the virtual-currency rails of the MMORPG platform.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure of Annual License, Annual Report, and Administration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Omission to file the annual corporate report with the Registrar, non-payment of the non-resident business license fee, failure to maintain a licensed registered agent, or abandonment of the corporate record books for more than 12 consecutive months.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Late penalty of USD 100 per month per report; business license surcharge of 10% of the fee plus daily interest; administrative dissolution and strike-off from the RMI corporate registry; revocation of the certificate of good standing needed for iTunes Connect and Google Play developer account renewals.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be prohibited from incorporating or managing a new RMI entity for up to 5 years; continuing to trade after dissolution exposes directors to personal liability for all contracts, app-store obligations, and merchant liabilities under common-law ultra vires doctrine; RMI courts may issue travel bans preventing departure from the country until unpaid state fees are settled.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Mispricing / Cross-Border Profit Stripping
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Setting intercompany royalties, management fees, or app-store settlement commissions at non-arm's-length rates between the MH_BC entity and related marketing, IP-holding, or distribution affiliates, or stripping profits through excessive group payments to zero-tax jurisdictions, where such amounts artificially reduce any RMI-source taxable base or the U.S. tax base under the Compact.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The RMI Tax Office may apply the Section 482 analog to reallocate income, disallow deductions, and assess the 32% headline rate plus interest and a 20% substantial-valuation-misstatement penalty; an adjustment may also trigger U.S. IRC Section 482 cross-border recharacterization of the Global MMORPG enterprise.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who execute or approve non-arm's-length contracts without supporting comparability studies are personally liable for the artificial deficiency under a fraudulent-conveyance theory; deliberate pricing manipulation may support criminal tax evasion charges with imprisonment up to 5 years, travel bans pending trial, and court-ordered civil restitution of the evaded tax plus penalties.
